description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus types used in the study, with each segment corresponding to a specific category and its percentage share. The chart is divided into eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, shown in a dark red color. Following this are “Press Release” at 18.7% (yellow), “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green), “Interview” at 8.8% (dark purple), “Organizational Report” at 7.7% (light purple), “Event Posting” at 6.6% (dark brown), “Organizational Website” at 4.9% (light purple), and “Email” at 2.7% (light green). The smallest segment is “Social Media Post” at 1.1% (orange), which is visually adjacent to the “Draft/Other” segment. The “Intra-agency” category is partially obscured by a gray bar at the bottom of the chart, preventing its label and percentage from being fully visible. Each category is labeled with its name and percentage outside the ring, and the chart does not include a separate legend. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending in size from the largest to the smallest, with the exception of “Press Release” and “External News Article” which are close in size and appear before “Interview.”
